title_zh: 按楼内说明把回收物和垃圾分开

scenario.label_zh: 核对家庭垃圾分类位置
scenario.goal_zh: 根据楼内说明分清瓶子、包装和电池的处理位置

context_zh: 新室友查看公寓楼的回收指引，确认瓶子、软包装和电池分别放在哪里。
author: author-phase04-b

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: Can we recycle this bottle with the glass? It looks clear, but I think it is made of plastic.

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: It is plastic. The leaflet for our building says bottles go in the blue bin, not the glass bin.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: What about this dirty food wrapper?

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: The same leaflet puts that with ordinary rubbish. The batteries go in a separate box by the entrance.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: All right. I will put the bottle in blue, the wrapper in the rubbish, and take the batteries downstairs.

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: Thanks. I will leave the leaflet here so we can check the next time we are unsure.
